multi_objective_gate.promote_if: hidden>=baseline-0.001 AND fresh>=baseline-0.001 AND safety_violations==0 AND candidate_pass>baseline_pass
multi_objective_gate.revert_if: hidden<-0.001 OR fresh<-0.001 OR safety_violations!=0 OR candidate_pass<=baseline_pass
multi_objective_gate.statistical_gate: PROMOTE requires per-question pass improvement AND McNemar exact p<0.05 AND bootstrap CI95 lower bound of overall-delta > 0; else HOLD (improvement not significant).

license_policy.note: 候选模型 license 命中 block 或未知时，即使性能更高也 BLOCK，不晋升生产版本；商用前须核对 LICENSE 原文。

evaluation_policy.anti_gaming: mutation 阶段禁止读取 hidden/fresh 任务；评分前校验 hash，失配即中止评估；无源文本的知识题题面已封口（不泄漏答案关键词），required 仅存于 rubric。
